returns without work when qword `02EBB7F0` is null; otherwise copies dwords `+0x10`, `+0x14` and `+0x1C` of the 0x180-byte entry at that pointer plus the sign-extended `ecx` times 0x180 to dwords `02EBB7F8`, `02EBB7FC` and `02EBB804`

makes the call at `003FFF70` + 0x19; when it returns non-zero, passes (0, that value, the stack buffer at `rsp+0x20`) to the call at `003FFF70` + 0x4D and, when that returns non-zero and the buffer's dword `+8` is non-zero, makes the call at `003FFF70` + 0x63 with (1, that dword); on every other path makes the call at `003FFF70` + 0x27 with `ecx` = 1; the frame carries the stack cookie from `01F44830`, checked through the call at `003FFF70` + 0x37 or `003FFF70` + 0x73

notes: 003FFF70: when the buffer dword is 0 the call at +0x27 receives edx = 0; on the other two paths into it edx is not set by this body. The return value (whatever the cookie-check call leaves in eax) is not stated.
